subject: Portal onboarding preflight — contract gap analysis & PO acknowledgement SLO
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@medsys.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Portal onboarding preflight — contract gap analysis & PO acknowledgement SLO

Elena —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. As we start the vendor portal enrollment (Ariba/Coupa) and MSA/order form handoff, I wanted to surface two legal/procurement items that will impact the activation timeline and the PO flow once we go live:

1) PO acknowledgement SLA: your team mentioned a 48-hour PO-ack target. Our standard order form currently references a 30-day PO acknowledgement window and a 7-day PO-accept window for electronic ACKs. Legal flagged that a 30-day window conflicts with your operational requirement — can you confirm whether MedSys can accept a 30-day vendor ack or needs the 48-hour requirement written into the order form?

2) Contract redlines: attached is our annotated MSA with a few points highlighted — indemnity reciprocity, data residency carve-outs, and the audit-event telemetry retention clause. We can compromise on telemetry retention but need explicit language for audit access (log retention 12 months).

I've attached a portal preflight checklist (portal_preflight_checklist.xlsx) and our current redline (redline_MSA_MedSys_v1.pdf). If you can share the buyer-side PO field mapping (PO XML or EDI spec) and your portal admin contact, we can align on the required field set for order acceptance and invoicing.

Proposed next step: 30-min follow-up tomorrow to agree the PO ack SLA and sign off on the minimal order form fields required to complete Ariba enrollment.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: portal_preflight_checklist.xlsx (xlsx), redline_MSA_MedSys_v1.pdf (pdf)

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@medsys.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Anders <t.anders@medsys.com>, MedSys Procurement <procurement@medsys.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:05:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Portal onboarding preflight — contract gap analysis & PO acknowledgement SLO

Markus —

Appreciate the summary and the checklist. A couple of clarifications from procurement: we cannot contractually accept a 30-day PO acknowledgement for mission-critical vendors. Our standard is 48 hours for ACK and 5 business days for acceptance/fulfillment confirmation for goods and services tied to clinical workflows. If Redwood needs flexibility, we can accept a 30-day acknowledgement only for non-clinical SaaS vendors, but that requires an explicit carve-out on the order form (section: scope of services).

On contract redlines: we reviewed the indemnity language and MedSys legal will not accept mutual full indemnity in the proposed form. They prefer a limited carve — vendor indemnifies for third-party IP claims and gross negligence only. For telemetry and audit logs, we can agree to 12-month retention but need clarity on access procedures (SLA for log exports) and a redacted export for PHI-sensitive fields.

I've attached our vendor registration PDF and the PO field spec (edi_po_spec_v3.xml) — Tom is the portal admin and will provide the technical mapping.

Tom, can you drop the EDI field mapping in the shared drive and confirm whether Ariba ID mapping will require a PO prefix (we typically use MEDS- as a prefix for integrated suppliers).

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Director, Strategic Sourcing
MedSys Health

Attachments: vendor_registration_form.pdf (pdf), edi_po_spec_v3.xml (xml)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:20:04 -0700
Subject: internal: MSA redline notes + order form approach

Markus / Priyom —

Quick internal notes after reading Elena's reply and the EDI spec:

- PO ACK SLA: we should aim to accept 48 hours on the Order Form only for the MedSys clinical-related SOWs. Operationally, Accept/Reject flows are implemented in the portal; forcing 48 hours broadly increases risk for other customers. Recommend: order form section "Acknowledgement SLA" with conditional language: "For clinical SOWs the vendor shall provide an electronic acknowledgement within 48 hours; for all other SOWs the vendor shall provide acknowledgement within 30 days."

- Indemnity: legal will not give full mutual indemnity. Proposed compromise language (short excerpt to include in redline): "Vendor indemnifies for third-party IP infringement and gross negligence; each party bears its own costs for indirect or consequential damages except where statute requires otherwise." Priyom — please expand this into the MSA redline and add a comment where we propose alternate liability caps tied to annual spend (we should not commit to unlimited exposure).

- Telemetry / Log export: agree on 12 months retention. Need to add a secure export process (SFTP with customer-managed keys) and a runbook for redaction of PHI. We can accept the retention if MedSys signs the runbook and SFTP key-handling ACLs.

I'll draft a short email to Elena with two attachments: updated redline (MA S_redline_v2) and a focused order form that includes the conditional ACK clause. I think that should keep the activation timeline intact.

Laura
Legal Ops
Redwood Inference

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 12:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Portal onboarding preflight — contract gap analysis & PO acknowledgement SLO

Elena —

Thanks for the quick turn. We've taken the team feedback and attached two documents for your review:

1) redline_MSA_MedSys_v2.pdf — reflects the proposed indemnity compromise (vendor indemnifies for IP and gross negligence only), a liability cap reference linked to annualized spend (section 9.2), and the telemetry retention language set to 12 months with an SFTP export and redaction runbook requirement.

2) orderform_MedSys_v1.docx — includes the conditional "Acknowledgement SLA" language: 48 hours for clinical SOWs; 30 days for all other SOWs. Also added a PO prefix field and optional EDI/PO_XML mapping notes to match the edi_po_spec_v3.xml Tom shared.

Please review and let us know if you can accept the indemnity compromise and the conditional ACK clause. If you agree, we can schedule a 30-minute legal-to-legal call Thursday 9:00 AM PT to sign off and hand the doc set to your portal admin for Ariba enrollment.

Tom — can you confirm the expected PO prefix (MEDS- or MEDSYS-) and whether Coupa will require an alternate ID mapping?

Thanks — look forward to wrapping this up quickly so we can start activation testing next week.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redline_MSA_MedSys_v2.pdf (pdf), orderform_MedSys_v1.docx (docx)
